name: Bengal Cube Open 2026

venue.name: Agrasain Bhawan
venue.address: Agrasain St, Liluah, Howrah, West Bengal 711204

information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.
Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.**

* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.
* Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
* Addition of any New Round on spot will be done only under the discretion of the Delegate with consultation of Organising team.

**Non-Veg Food is strictly prohibited in the Venue Premises.**
